subject: Request: Senior approval to allow 30% Hosted API concession for TempoHealth
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: senior approval to allow 30% Hosted API concession for TempoHealth

Team —

Quick summary: TempoHealth (primary care platform) is asking for a 30% reduction on Hosted API per-token pricing for a 24-month committed usage agreement. They are proposing a $3.2M committed spend (net of requested discount) with an expected ramp to ~120M tokens/mo by month 9. The deal is strategic: Tempo is integrating Redwood into their core patient triage flows (high throughput, low latency) and has strong channel potential for healthcare partners.

Why we should consider it:
- High committed spend with predictable multi-year revenue and upsell potential to Dedicated/Private later.
- Strong reference/market signal in healthcare (compliance posture acceptable).
- They are willing to sign a 24-month term + data processing addendum + standard security SOW.

Ask: senior approval for an exception to the pricing grid to allow a 30% Hosted API rate concession (list price -> 30% off) + a 3-month ramp credit against initial usage to help onboarding. This exceeds the 20% threshold and requires exec sign-off per deal desk policy.

Key constraints/conditions we propose:
1) Minimum committed ARR of $3.2M (after discount) and a 24-month term.
2) Automatic reversion to standard pricing if monthly usage falls below 60% of committed tokens for two consecutive months.
3) Legal to include a clause limiting indemnity exposure and requiring SOC2 evidence refresh within 90 days.

Attachments: TempoHealth_MA_plan.xlsx (commit schedule / usage forecast), SOW-TempoHealth-v2.pdf (security + SOW), redwood_risk_assessment.docx

I know this is outside our standard concession band; I have Ben on the thread for commercial details and Laura for finance impact. Jonas, quick legal note in-thread would be helpful.

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: senior approval to allow 30% Hosted API concession for TempoHealth

Marcus —

Thanks for the write-up. A few quick questions before I escalate to the exec committee:
- What's the blended gross margin at 30% off assuming the forecasted token mix (embedding vs generation)?
- Any alternative packaging (committed pool + overage tier) that would reduce downside?
- Is there an ask for onboarding professional services credits beyond the 3-month ramp?

If the numbers still show acceptable unit economics and legal signs off on limited liability terms, I'm open to raising to the Chief Commercial Officer for final exec signoff. Please reply with the P&L sketch and Ben's recommended guardrails.

Mina
Mina Haddad
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: senior approval to allow 30% Hosted API concession for TempoHealth

Mina —

Numbers attached (see TempoHealth_MA_plan.xlsx). Quick bullets: 
- Forecasted mix: 70% generation, 30% embeddings (higher comp cost on generation). At 30% off list, projected gross margin ~42% across year 1 (company-wide target is 50%). Margin improves to ~54% in year 2 as ramp efficiency and batching/kv cache reduces per-token cost.
- Alternative structure: 20% base discount + committed pool pricing with tiered overage (15% overage discount) — this reduces upside but keeps margin above 48% year-over-year. Tempo pushed back; they need headline 30% for procurement approval.
- No request for additional PS credits beyond standard onboarding (we're offering a single dedicated onboarding sprint — not discounted).

Commercial guardrails I'd recommend if we proceed:
1) 24-month firm commitment with quarterly usage reporting and a make-good clause if they materially under-deliver.
2) Auto-terminate ramp credit if we identify repeated misuse or excessive burst patterns.
3) Finance to hold a portion of the first-year revenue until SOC2 evidence is validated.

Laura — can you confirm the net ARR recognition impact and whether treasury is comfortable with the initial invoice schedule?

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 10:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: senior approval to allow 30% Hosted API concession for TempoHealth

All —

Legal notes on proposed concessions: 
- 24-month term + DPA + SOW is fine. We need to limit liability language to cap at fees paid under the agreement and carve out regulatory fines.
- Add a clause: SOC2 evidence must be provided prior to first volume invoice; if not provided within 90 days, Redwood may pause onboarding and suspend ramp credits.
- Recommend adding an audit right (limited to once per 12 months) and a clear data retention boundary for hosted model logs.

If finance confirms close tracking of revenues and margins (Laura), I'm comfortable with recommending exec approval conditional on those contract points.

-jw
Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jan 2028 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: allow 30% Hosted API concession for TempoHealth (exec clearance)

Marcus / Ben —

After reviewing the commercial sketch, legal notes, and finance impact, I am approving the 30% Hosted API concession for TempoHealth on a conditional basis. Conditions to include in the signature-ready agreement: 
1) 24-month firm commitment for the agreed token floors (as in TempoHealth_MA_plan.xlsx).
2) SOC2 evidence delivered within 90 days and validated by Security; first invoicing may be held until validation.
3) Auto-reversion to standard pricing if usage drops below 60% of committed tokens for two consecutive months.
4) Liability cap limited to fees paid; audit right and data retention clauses per legal recommendation.
5) Deal desk to capture final signature via DocuSign link and route counterparty PO to finance.

Ben — you have clearance to present these terms to the customer and to finalize SOW/DocuSign. Please ensure we capture the HubSpot deal stage update (DEAL-5932 -> Closed - Won pending docs).

Mina
Mina Haddad
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
